title: Hosanna to the Son of David

request.style: English, triumphant processional anthem, choir and orchestra with trumpets, snare drums and cymbals, crowd shouts, a march that grows and grows, 112 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They brought the donkey and the colt
And put their cloaks on them
And he sat on them
Most of the crowd spread their cloaks on the road

[Verse]
Others cut branches from the trees
And spread them on the road
And the crowds that went before him
And that followed him were shouting

[Chorus]
Hosanna to the Son of David
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord
Hosanna in the highest
Hosanna

[Verse]
And when he entered Jerusalem
The whole city was stirred up
Who is this, they said
This is the prophet Jesus from Nazareth of Galilee

[Chorus]
Hosanna to the Son of David
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord
Hosanna in the highest
Hosanna
